title: Yoniso Runtime Output
description: Machine-readable contract for a Yoniso assessment. scripts/validate_yoniso_output.py enforces this on the markdown form a model emits. The skill prompt GUIDES; this schema + validator ENFORCE.

assessment.description: Classified at the HIGHEST matching signal. Auto-classify wins over self-report.

min_why_layers.description: Base 2; HIGH->3; CRITICAL/security/data-loss/recurrence->4 (highest wins, not additive).

root_cause_chain.description: Each layer must pass 4 gates: Specific, Causal, Novel, Actionable.

fix_decision.description: Action-first. Leads with the change, not the explanation.

verification.description: How to confirm the fix works (test/command/observable signal).

feedback.description: Predicted vs actual severity; pattern knowledge update. Optional for the first pass.
